changes.title: Locks doc: what was seen of the NFC tag set-up in a running build
Locks: unlock with an NFC tag, a password set first as the backup
changes.detail:
A new way in, an NFC tag with a password as backup. The wizard makes the password first, then asks for the tag; either one opens the lock on its own, and the prompt waits for the tag with Use password instead.

A tag is heard through this browser's own reader (Web NFC) and through scans with the Home Assistant app (tag_scanned events), and the prompt says which it can hear. The two readings are kept apart. Only a salted hash of the tag's identity is stored, and a wrong tag spends the same attempt budget.

Checks: lock tests pass (65), including the tag alone, the password alone, the other reading of the same tag refused, and no lock without the backup password; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors. Not yet seen with a real tag.

changes.title: Teleport transition on every jump to an element; keep problems for Repairs
changes.detail:
Every jump to an exact element now plays one transition: a ring where the person pressed, a beam to the destination, the element materialising out of a bright blur under a scan line, then a fading glow. It plays for Teleport from Repairs, setting search results on Personal settings, backup settings and the AI page, and the dashboard editor's card jumps. Reduce motion skips it.

Problems found on other pages are kept in this browser so Repairs lists them after a reload. The spotlight now hugs the element instead of a large circle.

Seen in a running build: the dashboard card badge, details, Repairs list and Teleport at 1440 and 390 pixels, and the transition frame by frame.

changes.title: Problem detector: outline the exact element, Fix, steps by hand, Teleport from Repairs
changes.detail:
When a dashboard card or an automation step names an entity Home Assistant does not know, that exact card or step is outlined where it is with a Problem found badge. The badge opens the details: what is wrong, why it matters, Fix when the app can fix it (turning the step off), numbered steps to fix it by hand when it cannot, and Ignore.

The Repairs page lists every problem found in this session with Fix, Fix all, Ignore and Teleport. Teleport opens the right page, scrolls the element into view, spotlights it and opens the details beside it.

The overlay is one fixed layer above the page, so it reaches elements in any shadow root. Reduce motion stops the pulse, spotlight and entrances. Settings live in Profile, Browser. The badge text is ordinary interface text, so a personal wording file can rename it.

Checks: the new unit tests pass (7); type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors. Not yet seen in a running build.

changes.title: Modern redesign foundation: the design kit as the default theme
changes.detail:
Batch 42. The full modern redesign landed as canvases 23 to 27 with one style kit. Painting 126 boards page by page would take forever and drift, so this puts the kit where every page already looks: the default light and dark themes and the shared components. Unit tested only; nothing here has been seen in a browser, and the list of what to look at is in HANDOFF.md.

- Colours: surfaces, outline, text, a retuned primary scale, a new tertiary tone, and container pairs for primary, tertiary, warning, error and success. Custom primary colours and user themes still override. - Shadows, motion tokens (off under reduced motion, both the system setting and the accessibility tool) and heading weight 600 that the reading option still overrides. - Cards, buttons, the switch, dialogs, menus, list items, chips, fields and data table rows follow the kit through tokens and scoped styles; no public API changed. - Not done: the segmented control, the select field, per-row entrance.

Checks: full suite 7,065 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors. No test covers the colour values themselves.
changes.detail_yue: 第 42 批。成套現代設計到齊，一百幾塊板逐頁髹實髹到天光兼走樣，所以先由 地基落手：將設計套件變成預設主題同共用元件，全部頁面一次過跟住靚。顏色、 陰影、動態（開咗減少動態就即刻收聲）、標題粗幼、卡片、按鈕、開關、對話框、 選單、輸入框、表格列都跟返套件。自訂主色同用戶主題照樣話事。只係單元 測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇，要睇邊度已經寫低喺 HANDOFF.md。

changes.title: Modern remake, first slice: one navigation pane, page polish, lock prompt on top
changes.detail:
Batch 41. Design canvas 23-modern-remake landed; this builds its first slice. Unit tested only, nothing here has been seen in a browser yet.

- Navigation: a setting "One navigation pane" (off by default, in the profile, synced). When on, the rail steps aside and the tab pane carries Pages and System headings, Developer tools, Settings, Notifications with a count, a search field, the person's name and a home button on a top or bottom bar. The rail's own extras (edit mode, the update badge, Assist) are out of view while it is on. - Pages: settings home tiles on tinted icon containers and banners with an action pill; the automation editor's action bar floats; automation history has one Commit button at every width, not two below 901 px; the apps page says its one thing once instead of in two cards. - Locks: the remove prompt opened from the page tool panel was drawn underneath it. The panel is a popover in the top layer, where a z-index of 1000 counts for nothing. The prompt and the wizard now enter the top layer too. Found by viewing published build 137. - Hosting: compose.full.yaml uses `restart: always` and a memory limit (6 GB, HA_MATERIAL_FULL_MEMORY to change), both documented.
changes.detail_yue: 第 41 批。設計畫布 23 到貨，先起第一轉：導覽合併做一個窗格（預設關，想 試先自己開）；設定主頁啲圖示有返顏色底；自動化編輯器條操作列識浮喺度； 歷史頁終於得返一粒「提交」掣，唔使再二揀一；應用程式頁一句講完唔再講 兩次。另外捉到隻蟲：移除鎖個確認框畀工具面板冚住，z-index 寫到一千都冇 用，因為人哋喺頂層，而家大家一齊上頂層。完整託管改用 restart: always 加 6 GB 記憶體上限。全部只係單元測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇。
